comparison.objective: Sort sequentially released colored blocks from a moving conveyor into matching bins.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed interception, bimanual conveyor handling, color sorting, and bin placement.
comparison.success_condition: Full credit requires correctly placed stationary blocks, with no accumulation of missed blocks at the belt end; detailed geometric thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Dynamic sorting and interception do not test coaxial tooling, controlled hammer impacts, fracture mechanics, or fragment recovery.
